name: spread_dynamics_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when a 5-second bar's high-low range expands to 2× or more the 5-minute rolling average range, it signals a liquidity stress event — typically a stop-cascade execution, large institutional TWAP block completing, or aggressive momentum algo entry overwhelming resting orders. NIFTY's continuous futures depth means these stress bursts complete within 30-60 seconds and leave a directional overshoot as the aggressive initiator finishes, with resting limit orders on the other side temporarily absorbed. When the per-bar range contracts back below 1.5× normal (stress resolved), NIFTY futures market makers who widened their quotes and delta-hedged during the event begin rebalancing inventory, and VWAP-benchmarked algorithms resume passive fills at their benchmark prices — this systematic reversal flow drives a 40-60% reversion of the spike move within the next 60 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: Bar range expands to 2x the 5-min average then contracts below 1.5x, signaling liquidity stress resolution and fading the directional overshoot
